givenLegend.M1/P1: maternal/paternal homologs of chromosome type1, carrying distinguishable given variants A_m/A_p
givenLegend.M2/P2: maternal/paternal homologs of chromosome type2, carrying distinguishable given variants B_m/B_p
givenLegend.gameteSet: one chromosome of each represented type; all origin and chromatid symbols are supplied

models.givenStart: The same model diploid cell with two homologous chromosome pairs, already correctly depicted with sister chromatids. No segment exchange in this comparison.

givenCorrectAlternatives.pairOrientation: origins align alike for pair1 and pair2
pair2 orientation reversed relative to pair1

models.ownExplanationRequired: Explain why the independent orientation/distribution of different homologous pairs permits different whole-chromosome combinations. The correct alternatives and outcomes are supplied, not drawn or constructed by the learner.
models.scopeBoundary: Alternative given meioses, each with four gametes; not eight gametes produced by a single meiosis. No segment-exchange explanation or2^n counting task is assessed.

givenLegend.a/b: sister chromatids of one duplicated homolog
givenLegend.A_m/B_m: given maternal variants at corresponding regions A/B
givenLegend.A_p/B_p: given paternal variants at corresponding regions A/B
givenLegend.type2: unaffected chromosome type2 with a fixed correctly supplied gamete distribution; independent assortment is not assessed

models.givenExchange: Corresponding region B exchanged reciprocally between M1b and P1a, labelled non-sister chromatids of homologous chromosomes. Region A and the depicted centromere stay on the original chromatid.
models.ownExplanationRequired: Track the corresponding given regions and explain how their reciprocal exchange yields new combinations on the two involved chromatids, while the supplied chromosome types and corresponding regions are retained.
models.scopeBoundary: The whole before/after comparison, exchange location and correct gamete outcomes are supplied. No independent model construction, molecular cut/repair mechanism, chromosome-assortment explanation or quantitative task is assessed.

structuralModelDataChecks: PASS correct reciprocal regions and gamete type sets
